findings.title: Double-tapped breakers in main panel
findings.detail: Two circuits share a single breaker lug on three breakers, which can overload the connection.

findings.title: No GFCI protection at kitchen counter outlets
findings.detail: Four receptacles within six feet of the sink are not GFCI protected.

findings.title: Missing smoke alarm on lower level
findings.detail: No smoke alarm present outside the lower-level bedrooms.

findings.title: Roof covering at end of service life
findings.detail: Three-tab shingles show granule loss and cupping throughout; inspector estimates under two years remaining.

findings.title: Water heater past expected life
findings.detail: Unit manufactured 2009; typical service life is 10 to 12 years. No active leak observed.

findings.title: Corrosion visible on furnace heat exchanger
findings.detail: Surface corrosion noted; inspector recommends evaluation by an HVAC contractor before the heating season.

findings.title: Negative grading along north foundation
findings.detail: Soil slopes toward the foundation for roughly 20 feet, directing water at the wall.

findings.title: Scuffed paint and minor drywall damage
findings.detail: Wear at baseboard height along two walls. No structural concern noted.

findings.title: Pocket door binds in track
findings.detail: Door sticks partway and requires force to close.

findings.title: Worn caulk at tub surround
findings.detail: Caulk is separating at the tub-to-tile joint. No moisture detected behind the surround.
